none: PAS NCL-AE0241: Roman nail-cleaner strap end
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A cast copper-alloy nail-cleaner strap end of late Roman date, c . 350-410. The strap end is incomplete, missing the base/attachment form at the top of the object, but retains an oblong body extending to a tapered, notched terminal, identifying a nail-cleaner function.
